The knowledge compilation paradigm does the opposite: it completes knowledge structuring and QA-ification at write time, and directly obtains accurate answers at read time. This is a typical design philosophy of "spend effort when writing, enjoy convenience when reading."

In complex long-horizon tasks, issues such as network fluctuations, model timeouts, and unavailable external APIs are inevitable. The multi-model disaster recovery layer further ensures that a single model failure does not affect overall system availability.
